d:
Step into the enchanting atmosphere of Patan Durbar Square, Kathmandu, as Rishab Rikhiram Sharma presents a heartfelt mashup of Zara Zara and Tinka Tinka on the Sitar. These iconic melodies have touched countless hearts, and their fusion in this one-of-a-kind performance creates a deeply nostalgic and soul-stirring experience.
Rishab holds the distinction of being the first artist to perform a concert at the historic Patan Durbar Square, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Musicians:
Rishab Rikhiram Sharma – Sitar
Prashant Trivedi – Tabla
Karan Wadhwa – Bass
Pranay Verma – Guitar
